description: Retrieval benchmark for Mnemo. 60 seed memories drawn from a personal-assistant memory (profile, habits, people, side projects, home, health, interests, stack) and 50 natural-language queries with hand-labelled gold memory ids. Queries are paraphrases, not substrings, so this tests semantic recall rather than keyword match. `age_days` backdates created_at so the decay ranking is genuinely exercised: several facts are deliberately superseded by fresher ones, and the gold label points at the CURRENT truth.

memories.content: Pranav is a backend engineer who builds developer tools.
Pranav's primary programming language is Python.
Pranav is learning Rust on weekends.
Pranav's side projects all share a single PostgreSQL instance.
Pranav backs up his laptop every Sunday evening.
Pranav's home server is a single mini-PC with 16GB of RAM.
Pranav prefers dark mode in every editor and terminal.
Pranav drinks black coffee, no sugar, usually two cups before noon.
Pranav is allergic to peanuts.
Pranav is lactose intolerant and avoids milk-based desserts.
Pranav's sister Meera is studying architecture in Pune.
Pranav's running coach is Nikhil.
Nikhil prefers detailed pace logs over daily check-ins.
Pranav's friend Rahul is a product designer who reviews his interfaces.
Pranav's weekday alarm goes off at 6:15am.
Project Auren is an LLM-based document classification service.
Auren uses Claude Haiku for its classification calls to keep costs low.
Auren's p95 latency target is under 400 milliseconds.
Mnemo is a semantic memory API backed by Postgres and pgvector.
Mnemo ranks results by similarity multiplied by a time-decay factor.
Pranav's laptop is a 16-inch MacBook Pro with 32GB of RAM.
Pranav uses Neovim as his main editor.
Pranav's own repositories run CI on GitHub Actions.
Test coverage across Pranav's side projects sits around 78 percent.
Pranav never merges a change without a review pass, no exceptions.
Pranav lives in Bengaluru, in the Indiranagar neighbourhood.
Pranav's commute to the co-working space takes about 40 minutes by metro.
Pranav visited Japan in April and loved the trains.
Pranav's passport expires in November 2027.
Pranav prefers window seats on long flights.
Pranav runs 5 kilometres three mornings a week.
Pranav injured his left knee in a football match last winter.
Pranav's physiotherapist recommended swimming instead of running.
Pranav sleeps best around seven and a half hours a night.
Pranav takes vitamin D supplements every morning.
Pranav rotates his API keys every ninety days.
Pranav keeps his own data inside the ap-south-1 region.
Pranav's annual laptop security review is in the second quarter.
Pranav keeps all secrets in a password manager, never in the repo.
Pranav writes a blameless postmortem after every incident.
Pranav is reading Designing Data-Intensive Applications.
Pranav's favourite cuisine is Thai, especially green curry.
Pranav plays acoustic guitar, mostly fingerstyle.
Pranav dislikes phone calls and prefers text.
Pranav's birthday is on the 12th of March.
Mnemo's frontend is built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
Mnemo's API authenticates clients with a single shared API key header.
Mnemo rate-limits at 100 requests per minute per key.
The embedding model in use is all-MiniLM-L6-v2 at 384 dimensions.
Database migrations are managed with Alembic.
Pranav used to live in Delhi.
Pranav no longer lives in Delhi.
The old search service was written in Ruby and has been decommissioned.
Search now runs on the new Go service.
Pranav previously used Jenkins for CI before moving to GitHub Actions.
Pranav prefers appointments late in the afternoon, after 4pm.
Pranav blocks Wednesday mornings for deep focus work with no meetings.
Pranav's family trip to Goa happens every January.
Pranav volunteers at the local animal shelter every fourth weekend.
Urgent alerts reach Pranav on a dedicated phone line, not by email.
